'''Remedy''' was an [[MD-5 medical droid]] who served as the resident [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] at [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]] on [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]]. Fighters who needed medical attention after losing fights in the [[Dool Arena]] received free treatment from Remedy.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
